prompt.text:
Repair the buggy source below without changing the required API.

File contract: Write strict TypeScript module solution.ts and export the named function.
Required API: export function firstMinPerKey(keys: readonly string[], scores: readonly number[]): number[] | null
Behavior: Reject unequal key and score lengths. For each exact key choose the index with the smallest score, breaking ties by earliest index. Return chosen indices in order of each key's first appearance; empty inputs succeed with a non-null empty result.
Visible example: For keys ["b","a","b","a"] and scores [5,4,3,3], return [2,3].

Buggy source to repair:

export function firstMinPerKey(keys: readonly string[],scores: readonly number[]): number[]|null {if(keys.length!==scores.length)return null;const best=new Map<string,number>();keys.forEach((k,i)=>best.set(k,i));return [...best.values()]}

reference.code: export function firstMinPerKey(keys: readonly string[],scores: readonly number[]): number[]|null {if(keys.length!==scores.length)return null;const order:string[]=[],best=new Map<string,number>();keys.forEach((key,i)=>{const old=best.get(key);if(old===undefined){order.push(key);best.set(key,i)}else if(scores[i]<scores[old])best.set(key,i)});return order.map(k=>best.get(k)!)}
